_comment: Hydration policies for coolable mutable aggregates. Tenant/company scope, aggregate members, durable schema version/checksums, and archive columns are generated from the storage and durable-schema manifests. Placement generation is always resolved server-side. Reducer/id fields remain optional until reducer signatures expose a supported mutation target.

policies._comment: pos_order is the first coolable mutable aggregate. Its children remain listed so a future aggregate hydration cannot silently omit membership.
